answer: In this PoA network, each evaluator’s EigenTrust contribution is discounted with an exponential temporal half-life, so reputation decays unless an identity delivers sustained, reciprocal honest service. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths; coordinated clones cannot bootstrap one another or pass consensus. Thus lotus, willow, and pulse are merely labels until durable interactions earn weight.
